text:
marie: Hey folks — ran into a 404 when following the "owner" link on the KB page about Dedicated capacity. Looks like the frontmatter shortlink points at a retired S3 blob. Anyone actively owning the lifecycle for that doc?

aj: Oof, thanks for the ping. Can you paste the broken link so I can repro?

marie: Sure — hitting https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/dedicated returns a 404. In the file header: `owner: shortlink://s3/owners/dedicated-owner` (the shortlink redirects to a removed object).

samir: Quick check: our link-checker also flagged it in the last sweep. You can fix by replacing the frontmatter owner with a username or team handle — e.g. `owner: @kaori` — then run the lint. Fast sed if you want: 
```
sed -i 's|shortlink://s3/owners/dedicated-owner|@kaori|g' content/kb/serving/dedicated.md
```

kaori: I can own the doc for the next quarter and open a tiny PR to swap the shortlink to my handle and add an owners note. I'll also add the canonical doc path in the redirect map.

docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in /kb/serving/dedicated.md (severity: warning). Last scan: 2026-03-17T09:12:08Z.

marie: Thanks — if you can add `owner: @kaori` to the frontmatter and update the redirect map, that's 👍. Please include a short changelog entry so Product sees the owner rotation.

aj: For local verification, run: `yarn docs:check-links content/kb/serving/dedicated.md` or `npx linkinator http://localhost:3000/serving/dedicated --silent`. CI also runs link checks on PR.

kaori: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/4321 — title: "docs(kb): replace retired shortlink & assign owner for dedicated capacity". I tagged @marie and @aj for review and added changelog note.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for branch docs-kb-4321 — all link-checks passed in CI. :rocket:

marie: Awesome. After merge can someone run the redirect-cache invalidation? I don't have infra perms.

aj: I'll run the cache purge once the PR is merged. ping me in that thread and I'll do the invalidation and confirm post-merge.

kaori: Will merge after one quick review. I'll follow up with a short note in the docs-owners rota doc so the rotation is explicit. Thanks for the quick responses! :tada:
